messages:
emily.marketing: Quick sync — we need customer-facing status wording + comms timing for this morning's partial outage. Also decide what (if anything) to show on the webinar signup page.

noah.support: Impact: intermittent 5xx on text-generation endpoints from ~08:05-08:28 UTC. Retries sometimes succeeded. We're pulling affected account list now.

violet.prod: We rolled back a config at 08:28 and errors dropped. No indicators of data loss. Root cause under investigation.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-044 detected at 08:06 UTC: elevated 5xx on text-generation endpoints. Mitigation applied 08:28 UTC.

emily.marketing: Drafts below: short status line, customer email for affected accounts, and one-liner for webinar page. Keep tone factual and neutral.

emily.marketing: ```Status (short): We experienced a brief disruption affecting text-generation endpoints between 08:05 and 08:28 UTC. Mitigation was applied and services have returned to normal. We have not identified any customer data exposure at this time. We will publish a follow-up with details after investigation.

Customer email (affected accounts): This morning, some requests to Redwood's text-generation API returned 5xx errors between 08:05 and 08:28 UTC. Our on-call team applied a mitigation and service was restored. If you were affected, please reply with request IDs and timestamps so we can investigate impact on your usage.

Webinar signup note: Note: we experienced a brief service disruption earlier today that has been resolved. Services are operating normally (see status).```

reza.legal: Change "We have not identified" -> "We have not identified any customer data exposure at this time." Fine otherwise. Avoid technical terms like "rollback" in public text.

violet.prod: Agreed. Replace "rollback" with "mitigation". Also add "see status" to webinar note with link.

mike.sales: For webinar leads: do not send an outage email to pure prospects. For customers who are webinar registrants and were affected, AEs should get a DM list. Sales will prepare a short outreach template.

noah.support: Support will DM AE list for affected customers in 15m and send targeted emails within 60m. We'll also post an internal incident timeline for postmortem.

emily.marketing: Proposed timing: Marketing publishes the short status now, support sends targeted emails to affected customers within the hour, webinar banner note queued for next site update (non-urgent). No social or blog posts for now. Any objections?

mike.sales: No objections. Keep SDR outreach minimal and only for warm leads flagged by support.

reza.legal: Approved with noted phrasing change. Save all timeline notes for PIR.

incident-bot: Update: INC-2026-044 status posted by emily.marketing at 08:50 UTC.

emily.marketing: Thanks team 44d I'll post the live status URL here when it's up."
